content: The man who moves a mountain begins by carrying away small stones.
author: Confucius
explanation: Monumental achievements are simply the cumulative aggregation of unglamorous, repetitive micro-actions. By breaking immense challenges into atomic tasks, the impossible becomes inevitable.
practicalInsight: Take the largest project currently intimidating you and complete one 10-minute atomic task right now.
reflectionPrompt: What 'mountain' in your life feels overwhelming, and what is the single pebble you can move today?
